question: How does the version 1.3 renderer texture upload select, convert, and submit bytes from a decoded-image record?

scope.boundary: This packet establishes static record consumption, conversion and mip-source selection, and the backend call boundary. It does not claim runtime execution, texture contents, public format names, pixel channels, or visual output.

upload.method: current renderer-texture vtable slot plus matching format switch, dimension selection, temporary conversion, mip loop, backend calls, cleanup, and return structure
upload.result: The current upload consumes the seven-word record and uses the complete selection and submission control flow.

temporaryRecordConstructor.method: matching call position after the 0x38-byte allocation and matching format, width, and height inputs
temporaryRecordConstructor.result: The current upload uses this constructor for temporary decoded-image storage.

temporaryRecordAllocator.method: matching fallback allocation path for power-of-two temporary storage
temporaryRecordAllocator.result: The current upload uses the separate temporary allocation path before a direct source copy.

resampler.method: matching upload-local call position, source dimensions and pitch inputs, destination record fields, and selected-format argument
resampler.result: The current upload uses the non-power-of-two conversion helper.

backendUpload.method: matching two upload call sites and argument construction for direct and mip paths
backendUpload.result: The current base and mip paths converge on the same backend boundary.

decodedImageRecord.result: The upload reads the vptr-less seven-word layout established by the version 1.3 mip selector.

dimensionFlow.width: A nonzero r5 overrides decoded width +0x4 for renderer-texture field +0x20; zero selects the decoded width.
dimensionFlow.height: A nonzero r6 overrides decoded height +0x8 for renderer-texture field +0x24; zero selects the decoded height.
dimensionFlow.allocation: Decoded width and height are independently rounded up to powers of two for backend allocation and conversion decisions.
dimensionFlow.result: Logical texture dimensions and backend allocation dimensions remain separate decisions.

sourceSelection.directPath: A supported single-level uncompressed record whose dimensions require no conversion supplies its source from active record +0x10.
sourceSelection.temporaryPath: Numeric formats 1 and 2 allocate a 0x38-byte temporary object with the decoded-image record embedded at +0x10. Format 2 expands three source bytes to four and writes 0xFF as the fourth byte; format 1 is copied. The selected format-1 words are byte-swapped in place before submission.
sourceSelection.resamplePath: A supported non-power-of-two uncompressed record can pass through 0x82304B38 into temporary power-of-two storage.
sourceSelection.mipPath: Numeric formats 10 through 12, or records with multiple levels, call 0x821E0568 for a bounded level pointer and use 0x821E04A8 for the selected extent or pitch rule.
sourceSelection.result: The current upload chooses either the original record or a temporary record, then submits an exact selected pointer without establishing a guest-side tiling step.

entry.registers: r3 renderer texture; r4 decoded-image record; r5 width override; r6 height override
entry.allowed: Read only the seven metadata words at r4 +0x0 through +0x18.

directPreUpload.registers: r3 backend level or surface; r6 selected source; r7 selected upload format; r8 pitch; r10 rectangle pointer
directPreUpload.allowed: Record register values and the four rectangle words only.

mipPreUpload.registers: r3 backend level or surface; r6 selected level source; r7 selected upload format; r8 computed pitch; r10 rectangle pointer
mipPreUpload.allowed: Record metadata and pointer identity only.

return.allowed: Record status and renderer-texture backend pointer identity without reading texture bytes.

staticObservationContract.authorization: Static placement only. No runtime hook is added or authorized by this packet.

conclusion: Version 1.3 establishes the complete static decoded-image upload contract: seven-word input, optional temporary conversion, bounded mip selection, renderer dimension updates, and backend submission through 0x82578E00.
